bullets.text: Architected AI-powered financial intelligence over 7 years of FOMC history combining Python pipelines multi-agent reasoning and retrieval to cut macro analysis from 3 days to under 20 minutes.
Engineered an event-driven FastAPI pipeline on AWS over 7 years of FOMC data cutting macro analysis from 3 days to under 20 minutes at 67.7% accuracy.
Built a Python and LangChain 3-agent RL debate system achieving 60% directional accuracy across 30 S&P 500 stocks on 7d 30d and 90d forecasting windows in production.
Built a production Python RAG pipeline with LangChain vector retrieval and AWS inference APIs delivering 18% accuracy lift in macro analysis evaluations.
Architected a Python and GCP-based AI radiology platform that processed 10K+ brain MRI studies and reduced tumor segmentation from 3 hours to 2 minutes.
Built a React and TypeScript clinician dashboard for a 20-person research team to review MRIs, prior studies, and AI segmentations with interactive mask refinement.
Developed a PyRadiomics feature extraction pipeline that generated 200+ quantitative biomarkers for prognosis modeling and clinical research.

Delivered 3 years of Fortune 500 platforms for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile with Java backend services and React/Angular on AWS Azure GCP spanning secure insurance exchange for 3,000 employees.
Replaced Oracle CRM with an in-house operations platform on React and MongoDB serving onboarding timesheets and reviews for 3,000 employees in production.
Standardized yearly performance reviews on React and MongoDB across 10+ manager teams replacing manual evaluation workflows for 3,000 employees in production.
Automated timesheet submission on AWS Lambda and SQS for 3,000 employees eliminating manual weekly filing across production operations.
Engineered FastAPI and PostgreSQL services powering application tracking, search APIs, and production data synchronization across the platform.
Deployed the platform on Cloudflare Pages and Workers with Docker, maintaining 99.9% uptime across 2K+ daily production queries.
Built a Spring Cloud API Gateway securing the platform with JWT authentication, Redis token-bucket rate limiting at 5 req/s, and Resilience4j circuit breakers.
Deployed Netflix Eureka service discovery and a Spring Cloud Config Server with encrypted secrets across 8 Docker Compose microservices.
